Um tour rápido pelo que tem em cada luga: A quick tour of what's where. It takes a minute; you can skip it and take it again later in Learn.
Começa uma conversa no chat. Atalho: Ctr: Starts a new chat. Shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + O.
No modo Code o Claude trabalha numa past: In Code mode Claude works in a folder on your computer: it reads and creates files, edits spreadsheets and runs commands, always with your OK.
Peça como pediria a uma pessoa. Digite /: Ask the way you would ask a person. Type / to see the shortcuts (commands, skills and workflows).
Imagens, PDFs, planilhas e arquivos de t: Images, PDFs, spreadsheets and text files. You can also drag them in or paste them.
Haiku para o simples (rápido e baratíssi: Haiku for simple things (fast and very cheap), Sonnet for everyday work, Opus for the hard stuff.
Quanto o Claude pensa antes de responder: How much Claude thinks before answering. More reasoning solves harder problems, but costs more.
Vem ligada: o Claude pesquisa na interne: It comes on: Claude searches the internet when the answer needs something current. Click to turn it off in this chat.
Tokens, dias seguidos, o mapa de calor e: Tokens, your day streak, the heatmap and the forecast: on which day your monthly cap runs out at your pace.
Tarefas grandes divididas em etapas, cad: Big tasks split into steps, each on its own model. They always ask for your OK first, with the estimated cost.
Pedidos que o Claude faz sozinho no horá: Requests Claude runs on its own, on the schedule you choose.
Pacotes de skills, agentes e comandos pa: Bundles of skills, agents and commands for kinds of work: office, writing, programming and more.
Lições curtas do zero e um glossário. Ca: Short lessons from scratch and a glossary. Every lesson has a helper to answer your questions.
Quanto custa cada modelo e se a API sai: What each model costs and whether the API is cheaper than the subscription for the way you use it.
Quanto você já gastou e o teto. Chegando: How much you've spent and your cap. When you reach it, Clave stops (or just warns you, if you prefer).
Sua chave da API, o teto, a personalizaç: Your API key, the cap, personalization, language and everything else.
A pasta em que o Claude trabalha. Ele só: The folder Claude works in. It only touches things inside it. Switch here or choose another one.
Liga o modo Livre: o Claude muda arquivo: Turns on Auto: Claude changes files and runs commands without asking. Deleting and publishing still ask for your OK.
Quanta liberdade ele tem: Perguntar, Ace: How much freedom it has: Ask, Accept edits, Plan (only reads and presents a plan) or Auto.
O que ele sabe da pasta: What it knows about the folder
Regras da pasta (CLAUDE.md) e skills que: The folder's rules (CLAUDE.md) and the skills it will follow.
Para que serve cada um. Clique num cartã: What each one is for. Click a card to see what changed and the price.
No ritmo dos últimos dias, quanto o mês: At your recent pace, how the month will close and when the cap runs out.
Diga como você usa o Claude normal e vej: Tell it how you use regular Claude and see what that would cost on the API, model by model.
Os fluxos prontos, os agentes que fazem: Ready-made workflows, the agents that run the steps, and everything that has run.
Mostra as etapas e o modelo de cada uma,: Shows the steps and each step's model, with the estimated cost. Use it in chat or in Code; it always asks for your OK before running.
Abre ao lado da conversa, com a largura: It opens next to the chat, as wide as you want (drag its edge). Ctrl + J opens and closes it.
A pasta inteira: abra qualquer arquivo n: The whole folder: open any file in the viewer, rename, create or send to the Recycle Bin.
O PowerShell de verdade, já na pasta. O: The real PowerShell, already in the folder. The "Send to Claude" button takes the output to the chat.
Você e o Claude usam o mesmo. O botão Lo: You and Claude use the same one. The Local button opens the sites running on your computer. To click or type on a site, Claude asks for your OK.
O que está rodando em segundo plano: res: What is running in the background: replies, workflows, routines, servers and downloads, with a Stop button.
